title: Aureline M5 artifact-diff packet
description: Canonical per-domain deterministic artifact-diff packet for the release and emergency-hotfix build lanes. Names the resolved exact build identity, the artifact families compared, the deterministic-diff ledger, the candidate-vs-rebuild check, the divergence-or-missing reference, the attestation state, and the last diff revision, and tracks whether every claimed artifact family (binaries, packages, docs packs, schemas, SBOMs, symbols, source maps, and rollback metadata) diffed byte-identically, diffed to a normalized equivalent, or came from a hermetic clean-room rebuild, so a green build can never omit a claimed artifact family from the diff, an artifact family is never diffed against a different build identity, and a material artifact divergence or an omitted family is a shiproom blocker rather than a warning-only state. Downstream release-center, shiproom, diagnostics, provenance, docs, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a lane's artifact-diff completeness by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
